name: @emdash-commerce/core
description: Native EmDash Commerce Core plugin, bridge, admin pages, and storefront client.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit false --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --jsx react-jsx --skipLibCheck --declaration --declarationMap --sourceMap --outDir dist --rootDir src src/index.ts src/admin.tsx
scripts.test:consumer: pnpm --filter @emdash-commerce/contracts build && pnpm build && node test/package-consumer.mjs
